It carries neither the opt-in contract item the first half of the cell paraphrases ("2. **A one-command hermetic suite** invocable against a copy — mado's gate takes `bash "$MUTANT" --selftest`; it must exercise the copy it is handed…", now at `:841-845`) nor the failure rule the second half paraphrases. `:851-855` at C0 is "4. Nothing else. The service never edits, repairs or re-pins the gate; a needed change is a recommendation to the owner (round-6 anti-claim, `plans/round-6.plan.md:23-25`)." plus the `### The protocol — ordered, fail-closed` heading; the `MUTATE: SETUP (<reason>)`, exit 2 — no headline rule and the red-control exit-2 rule it points at are now at `:868-872`.
